sources.title: Understanding human metacontrol and its pathologies using deep neural networks
sources.verified_scope: Observe-or-bet bandit tasks with stochastic reversal of intended bet actions; a second task includes an efficacy-increasing action with opportunity cost. The auxiliary output predicts intended/realized action mismatch. In tested LSTM/REINFORCE networks it improved adaptation relative to standard and parameter-matched variants receiving comparable information.
sources.boundaries: This establishes a result for the tested tasks and model comparisons, not a theorem that an explicit head is universally necessary or that Hepta will benefit. Prediction of reward or correctness is distinct from prediction that the intended action was realized.
sources.implementation_inference: Log intended and realized actions separately, train the auxiliary head from observed match/mismatch, and compare matched-capacity/data controls. Audit terminal content identity before using such labels.

sources.title: Thalamic regulation of reinforcement learning strategies across prefrontal-striatal networks
sources.verified_scope: Human tactile probabilistic reversal learning, fMRI, and CogLinks circuit modelling relate mediodorsal-thalamic context inference to flexible switching. The model explains some slower updates as failures to form alternative context representations; imaging analyses test related predictions.
sources.boundaries: The article cautions that blocks classified as model-free/model-based need not be pure strategy types. It does not evaluate a Hepta controller or establish the net benefit of purchasing computation.
sources.implementation_inference: Treat context-dependent escalation to additional planning as a hypothesis. Compare paid STOP-versus-continuation outcomes with a strong light policy under matched costs and evidence.

label_contract_inference.selected_used: Whether the intended selected object is the object actually delivered/used, independently of terminal correctness.
label_contract_inference.declared_effect: Whether a separately specified observable local-effect predicate occurred; keep nullable if not observed.
label_contract_inference.continuation_value: Expected terminal utility change relative to STOP minus all incremental execution and control costs.
label_contract_inference.read_boundary: An information-only READ followed by immediate STOP need not change terminal content. Any READ-and-answer/rerank suffix must be explicitly declared and fully costed.
label_contract_inference.attribution: These are proposed engineering contracts inferred from the scoped evidence, not results claimed by the cited papers.
